---
description: Plan how to build it (small, atomic tasks)
---

Use the skills in .github/skills to create a small, atomic implementation plan from an approved spec.\n\nFocus on:\n- Sequenced steps\n- Dependencies and order\n- Verification point per step\n- Rollback considerations\n\nKeep tasks independently testable.\n\nWhen you write the plan, format implementation tasks as markdown checkboxes using [ ] so they can be updated during execution.
